summary: Shoshone County lookout built in 1938 as a 50-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab; its patrol point sat one mile east, atop Boulder Creek Ridge; abandoned in 1948 and listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Abandoned 1948; no source describes what remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up; no source says whether the ground is open to the public

notes_for_editor: Only four sources, all short. None describes staffing, fires, or the site today. Coordinates differ: the firelookout.org index gives 47.43280, -115.83290 (matches the record's ffla point), while the brief's idaho_fl point 47.43076, -115.82516 is about 0.6 km away; not settled here. idaholookouts.weebly.com/gold-hill.html covers a different Gold Hill (Latah County, 42N-4W-23); its 1915 Harvard telephone item is not this lookout and was not used.
